name: Brawl
description:
Small, open template inspired by Elka and Hypercube.

Sizes from S to M and everything inbetween (recommended size is 48x48) and 2 players on Brawl.

Sizes from S+U to M+U and everything inbetween (recommended size is 52x52 with Underground) and 4 players on Brawl FFA

Trade: Roll a pair of Towns and flip a Coin. The winner of the coinflip chooses either Town or Color and the loser makes the other choice.

Banned objects: Sanctuary, Tavern, Stables, Redwood Observatories. Enabled objects: Cover of Darkness.

Recommended settings for Brawl (1 vs 1):

Size: S or M
Players: 2
Monsters: strong
Roads: no
Water: none (S size) or normal (M size)
Difficulty: 160 or 200%
Simultaneous turns: None
Timer: 8-4-1:30
Restarts: None
author: Warzyw647 and Wnukos, Chinese translation by Ziyue

chinese.name: 小型混战地图模板
chinese.description:
两个小型混战随机地图模板。
brawl模板：单层地图，尺寸从S到M（推荐尺寸48x48），2人对战；
brawl-ffa模板：双层地图，尺寸从S+U到M+U（推荐尺寸52x52），4人对战。
地图上无道路或只有城镇和矿区间的泥路。
建议200%难度开局，不设置同步回合，选择时长较短的计时器。
对战规则：双方各掷出一个城镇，再掷硬币，胜方先选择城镇或颜色，负方则选择剩下的。
（建议开启【决斗模式】）
